page.notes: The first letter of "Mirandam" is a large woodcut-style initial M, joined to the word. Small capitals are set as capitals: BILIBALDI, PIRCKEIMERūM, DÜRERUS, IMHOFIO, JANE. The tilde over the u of PIRCKEIMERūM stands for a left-out m. Red or orange underlines run through several lines of the verse; they are marks added to the copy, not printed text, and are left out. A small "C" stands at the top centre above the heading and a small "c" at the left edge of the page; these are stray marks, not printed signatures, and are left out. The rest of the page is clear.
